original_test_intent: Query one identified sensor's current raw reading and status using Get Sensor Reading, validate that the response belongs to the intended sensor, and interpret availability and event state without changing the platform.
original_method: Master specifies raw 0x04/0x2d <Sensor number> through in-band localhost and out-of-band lanplus, with generic log clearing and success-only criteria. Both source methods remain preserved; Project SPEC determines the executed path and coverage claim.
manual_activity: Owner provides the target sensor, approved in-band or out-of-band access path and any project-specific acceptable range; routine protected collection and decoding are automatable.
required_inputs: Validated sensor number and SDR record
Sensor type, units and conversion coefficients
safety_requirements: Do not use sshpass or command-line passwords
Do not replace the selected sensor with a wildcard query
Handle unavailable and initial-update state explicitly
Do not mutate thresholds, hysteresis, event controls or chassis/BMC state
agent_execution_scope: Resolve one sensor number from SDR
Decode reading byte and sensor status/event fields
Apply SDR conversion only with authoritative coefficients
Compare to an approved range when supplied
Return redacted raw and structured evidence
engineer_actions: Approve target/access path and any expected value
Resolve unsupported sensor conversion or contradictory status

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Not fit: it exposes credentials, disables host authentication, changes the target from one sensor to all sensors and truncates fallback evidence, so it cannot prove the original command's coverage.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use protected local execution for `ipmitool raw 0x04 0x2d <validated-sensor-number>` or a host-verified secret-safe remote wrapper. If an approved project chooses out-of-band access, inject credentials securely and record that in-band coverage remains unverified.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The original 0x04/0x2d sensor-number semantics and 10/5 timing are retained; no wildcard, sensor number, credential or expected reading is invented.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Resolve one sensor from authoritative SDR data, use an approved secure interface, validate the raw response and status bits, then convert and compare the reading only with sensor-specific metadata and project criteria.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Removes evidence clearing and insecure plaintext access from the recommendation, retains one-sensor scope, and adds response semantics beyond transport success.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: An out-of-band substitution can validate the BMC command but not necessarily the original in-band transport. A wildcard high-level sensor listing is not equivalent to the selected raw response.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A plausible value from the wrong sensor, stale/unavailable state or incorrect SDR conversion can produce a false PASS even when the command exits successfully.

project_override_considerations: Tool or transport may be overridden with engineering approval only when sensor identity, raw-field semantics and coverage equivalence are recorded; any untested in-band or out-of-band source method must remain explicit.
expected_evidence: Sensor number, SDR identity, type and conversion metadata
Redacted exact request and raw response
Converted value, units and coefficients when applicable
Project range/tolerance comparison or readiness-pending note
Proof logs and configuration were unchanged

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source correctly names 0x04/0x2d but combines in-band and out-of-band methods, exposes a command-line password, clears logs and accepts only no transport error. DeepSeek further changes scope to a wildcard query with sshpass and disabled host verification. Review preserves all source text while rejecting those recommendations and restoring one-sensor semantic validation.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The command and read-only objective are clear. Target sensor, protected access, conversion metadata and expected range are execution-readiness inputs, not a permanent review blocker.

review_improvement: Restores exact sensor identity, secure access, status-aware parsing, SDR conversion provenance and meaningful evidence while distinguishing command success from a valid sensor result.
independent_technical_reasoning: Get Sensor Reading returns a raw value together with status and event bytes. A zero exit code cannot establish that the value is usable: the sensor may be unavailable, updating, disabled or decoded with the wrong linearization. Exact SDR identity is therefore part of the evidence chain. A wildcard query also loses the requested raw-command and transport coverage, while insecure SSH practices create an avoidable credential risk unrelated to the test objective.
